title: OTP Behavior
description: x-otp replaces the element's content with length single-digit boxes for a one-time code: typing moves to the next box, and non-digits are rejected.

$view.name: input
$view.description: One box per digit, `length` of them: type=text, inputmode=numeric, maxlength=1. Typing a digit moves focus to the next box; Backspace in an empty box moves back.

getValue.description: The code typed so far, the boxes' digits joined in order. Reached as element.wbOtp.getValue().

events.wb:otp:input: Fired by otp() on the host each time a box changes; detail.value is the code typed so far.
